metadata.title: Self-Aware Memory Gap Detection & Autonomous Research

story.iWant: Jarvis to autonomously detect gaps in its memory and proactively research to fill them
story.soThat: the system evolves from passive RAG retrieval to active knowledge-seeking intelligence
story.tasks: Task 1: Implement Gap Analysis Engine (Coverage/Recency/Coherence) Task 2: Build Research Planning Interface (Gemini query generation + limits) Task 3: Integrate MCP Tooling for Web Research (fetch/browser orchestration, quality scoring) Task 4: Implement Critical Integration Layer (Claude conflict detection + synthesis) Task 5: Build Temporal Chunk Manager (versioned chunks with provenance + migration) Task 6: Add Research Mode to Query Path (CLI/API flags, gap analyzer hook, response formatting) Task 7: Implement Rate Limiting & Cost Caps (Redis-backed, configurable) Task 8: Build Research Analytics & Logging (Postgres schema, CLI/API dashboard) Task 9-15: Web UI research controls, progress indicators, gap display, research summary, enhanced attribution Task 16-18: Web UI error states, mobile responsiveness, accessibility/polish Task 19: Documentation & examples for research mode Task 20: Integration testing & validation (end-to-end gaps → research → updates)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Gap analysis: coverage score 0-1, recency classification (MISSING | SPARSE | STALE), coherence contradiction flag. 2. Research mode triggers when gaps exceed threshold; generates 2-5 web queries via Gemini, executes with MCP tools, cross-references and validates sources. 3. Critical integration compares old vs new knowledge, detects conflicts, synthesizes updates, and reports confidence deltas. 4. Temporal memory updates are versioned with source_type, verified_at (UTC), confidence, supersedes links, append-only history. 5. User transparency: response includes gap summary, research summary, confidence before/after, links to new sources, cost/provider metadata. 6. Logging & analytics: research sessions logged to Postgres with gaps, queries, sources, updates, cost/usage, status. 7. Opt-in controls: CLI flag and API param to enable research (off by default) plus rate limiting and cost caps.

doc.title: Variable Grounding System
doc.snippet: Describes autonomous grounding with intent analysis, evidence tagging, and creative vs strict modes that can be reused for gap detection thresholds and response transparency.

doc.title: Breakthrough Session
doc.snippet: Captures the shift to balancing creativity with sources (“creative context”) and outlines stability fixes in chat grounding, relevant to keeping research responses grounded.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Defines semantic, hybrid, and expanded retrieval with required source attribution—baseline behaviours that research mode must extend without breaking.

dependency.packages: fastapi, uvicorn, structlog, sqlalchemy, alembic, redis, qdrant-client, pydantic(+settings), typer, httpx, sentence-transformers, pytest/ruff/black/mypy
dependency.reason: Core stack for API, storage, retrieval, logging, CLI, and testing; research tooling must stay within these ecosystems.

story-context.constraints: Use structured logging (structlog) and keep functions typed (mypy: disallow_untyped_defs). Follow Black/ruff 100-char lines. Preserve timezone-aware UTC timestamps for verified_at and logs. Reuse shared retrieval/prompt paths (do not fork RAG logic). Configuration must conform to JSON-valid YAML in config/settings.yaml. Never fabricate citations; speculation must be labeled per grounding level.

interface.name: POST /api/chat
interface.signature: Body: ChatRequest(message, enable_research?, auto_grounding?, strict_mode?, k, retriever, expand, provider)

tests.standards: Pytest with strict markers, coverage enforced (`--cov=jarvis --cov-report=term-missing`), lint/type gates via ruff/black/mypy; observability requires structured logs with latency/provider metadata (per docs/test-design-system.md).
tests.ideas: AC-1: Unit tests for Coverage/Recency/Coherence analyzers with edge scores and classification thresholds. AC-2: Research planner tests enforcing query count limits and MCP execution mocks for fetch/browser flows. AC-3/4: Integrator tests for conflict detection and confidence delta math plus versioned chunk supersedes handling. AC-5/7: API/CLI integration tests toggling enable_research, verifying response transparency and rate/cost enforcement with Redis fakes. AC-6: DB logging tests ensuring research sessions capture gaps, queries, sources, costs, and statuses; migrations round-trip.
